headline: Alex nabs third as Grandad’s title tilt takes a dent
text: Recent action gave England (Alex) a lift with a 6-4 win over France (Carolina), but the earlier semi-final loss to Argentina (Nana) meant no final spot. France (Carolina) also came unstuck against Spain (Grandad). So the big winners were Argentina (Nana) and Spain (Grandad), while France (Carolina) took the heaviest knock. Overall, Max is still top on 30 points, with Grandad breathing down the neck on 29. At the other end, Sofia is bottom on 10, with Christopher not far above on 11. A tidy little scrap at both ends, innit?
